title: COMET: Decoupled Distillation, Routing, and Capacity Control for Task-Agnostic Continual Vision--Language Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. translated_title: COMET：面向任务无关持续视觉-语言学习的解耦蒸馏、路由与容量控制
translated_abstract: 像CLIP这样的视觉-语言模型（VLM）保留了零样本识别能力，但其在开放世界中的应用往往需要任务无关的持续学习：任务按顺序到来，历史数据不可用，任务身份未知，且主干网络无法重新训练。我们认为，这一设定通过超出稳定性-可塑性权衡之外的三种耦合压力使VLM失效：(1) 模态一致性漂移，(2) 表示空间干扰，(3) 每任务容量不足。我们提出COMET（协作式专家混合迁移，Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer）来分别解决这三个问题：冻结的教师模型仅在共享的图文池上提供特征参考；三重亲和力蒸馏（Tri-Affinity Distillation）保持图像-图像、文本-文本和图像-文本的几何结构；学生感知的跨专家蒸馏（Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation）将新专家与兼容的先验专家对齐，使路由错误能够优雅退化。我们将COMET设计为保持容量与推理……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出COMET框架，通过冻结教师的三重亲和力蒸馏、学生感知的跨专家蒸馏以及解耦的路由与容量控制，解决任务无关持续学习中的模态一致性漂移、表示空间干扰和每任务容量不足三大问题。
en_tdlr: COMET enables task-agnostic continual learning for vision-language models by addressing modal-consistency drift, representation-space interference, and per-task capacity shortfall through frozen-teacher tri-affinity distillation, student-aware cross-expert distillation, and decoupled routing and capacity control.
